findings.description: The osvcheck hook leaves an untracked root cache file after normal use.
findings.analysis: The existing `.*_cache/` ignore pattern applies only to directories, while osvcheck creates a file. Every ordinary hook run therefore leaves working-tree noise.
findings.recommendation: Remove the directory-only slash from the existing generic `.*_cache/` rule so it ignores cache files and directories.
findings.rationale: A generic cache rule is already established. It should cover generated cache files as well as directories, rather than naming osvcheck specifically.

findings.description: The bare `ty check` system hook can be unavailable when Ty is installed only in the project’s uv environment.
findings.analysis: The repository’s documented commands run Ty through uv. A bare executable depends on a separately installed host tool and can make Python commits fail on a fresh project environment.
findings.recommendation: Use a local `uv run --frozen ty check` hook so it uses the locked project environment.
findings.rationale: Retain a local Ty hook, but execute it with uv’s frozen project environment to avoid a globally installed executable and align it with CI’s dependency policy. The remote Ruff hook remains pinned and self-contained in pre-commit’s environment, so it does not rely on a globally installed executable.

findings.description: A fresh clone has no contributor-facing instruction to install the repository’s pre-commit Git hook.
findings.analysis: Git hooks are local metadata and are not cloned. The configuration alone does not activate checks for another contributor until they run `pre-commit install`.
findings.recommendation: Add concise contributor setup guidance for `pre-commit install`.
findings.rationale: The repository’s local installation is the intended scope of this change. Contributor setup guidance is not required here.

findings.description: The pytest hook can resolve or update dependencies when the lockfile is stale, unlike CI’s frozen invocation.
findings.analysis: The local hook currently uses `uv run pytest`; CI uses a frozen environment. A frozen local invocation would prevent an implicit lockfile update and align dependency resolution with CI.
findings.recommendation: Use `uv run --frozen pytest -Walways -Werror` for the pytest hook.
findings.rationale: The local hook should use the committed lockfile, matching CI and preventing an implicit dependency resolution or lockfile update during commit.
